description: Manual corrections applied after the automatic attribution sources. Each entry records the evidence for the decision so the correction is auditable rather than hidden in a matcher tweak.

reject.reason: Directory row 99 reads 'bhadpurapurmun.gov.np', a duplication in the source. The hostname does not resolve, while the separately sourced bhadrapurmun.gov.np does.

Wikidata P856 points at Shivaraj Municipality in Kapilvastu; the page title is 'Shivaraj Municipality' and the hostname does not match Shivapuri. The directory hostname shivapurimun.gov.np is retained instead.
The hostname names the district rather than the local level, the same ambiguity that excludes province portals. The directory hostname phunglingmun.gov.np is retained instead.
Directory row 200 omits a syllable; manrashiswamun.gov.np does not resolve. The correct spelling manarashiswamun.gov.np resolves, so the typo is rejected and the corrected hostname is accepted below.

accept.evidence_note: Directory row 200 lists Manara Shisawa Municipality with the typo manrashiswamun.gov.np (NXDOMAIN). The corrected hostname manarashiswamun.gov.np resolves and matches the name.
